classification.difficultyReason: Infer two missing boundary lengths of an L-shaped region, form its perimeter equation and solve for x.

content.prompt: The perimeter of the shaded region is $36\text{ cm}$. Find the value of $x$.

spec.sourceRegion: Review exercise question 11, middle L-shaped diagram
spec.description: Closed orthogonal L-shaped region with an upper-right notch. Preserve four given dimension labels and the four printed right-angle marks. Drawing coordinates express topology and source proportions, not additional measurements. Ordinary source blue outlines and marks become black; the named shaded region uses house light blue.
spec.mathematics: Top length 2x cm; downward inner step x cm; rightward step x cm; total left height 6 cm. Bottom length is 3x cm and the remaining right vertical length is (6-x) cm; these inferred lengths are not printed on the question diagram.
spec.answerVisibility: Only source givens are visible; inferred lengths and x=4 appear in answers.

answer.short:
$x=4$.

Use the missing lengths $3x\text{ cm}$ and $(6-x)\text{ cm}$ to form the perimeter equation.
answer.worked:
The bottom edge is $2x+x=3x\text{ cm}$, and the unlabelled right edge is $(6-x)\text{ cm}$.

$$\begin{align*}2x+x+x+(6-x)+3x+6&=36\\6x+12&=36\\6x&=24\\x&=4\end{align*}$$
